title: Developing plant-based meat analogues using red yeast rice powder: color stability, structural reinforcement, and antioxidant enhancement.
authors: Gao, Chaofan; Yang, Jiafei; Dai, Huihui; Lai, Rui; Guo, Yiting; Zhu, Xueqing; An, Hongzhou
journal: Journal of the science of food and agriculture
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红曲米粉对植物基肉制品颜色、结构和抗氧化性的影响，属于食品加工领域，不涉及蛋白质结构计算建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Plant-based meat is limited by the absence of heme, which hinders the simulation of animal meat color. This study evaluated the effects of red yeast rice powder (RYRP), added as a natural colorant at 0%, 1%, 3%, 5%, and 7%, on the color, structure, and antioxidant properties of high-moisture textured vegetable protein (HMTVP). RESULTS: Red yeast rice powder significantly improved the meat-like color of HMTVP, with 5% addition exhibiting color characteristics closer to those of fresh beef tenderloin, particularly in terms of redness (a*). The color remained relatively stable during heating at 60  degrees C and under dark frozen storage. Structural analysis showed that low addition levels (1%) led to a looser protein structure and reduced the degree of texturization. Conversely, higher addition levels (3%) promoted the transformation of the fibrous structure from disordered to compact and ordered by enhancing intermolecular interactions, and also affected water distribution. Red yeast rice powder also increased the in vitro antioxidant activity of HMTVP in a dose-dependent manner. CONCLUSION: Red yeast rice powder can effectively improve the color, structural properties, and in vitro antioxidant activity of HMTVP. These findings indicate the potential of this natural colorant for improving the color and overall quality attributes of plant-based meat products. (c) 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
abstract_zh: 背景：植物基肉因缺乏血红素而受限，这阻碍了对动物肉颜色的模拟。本研究评估了以0%、1%、3%、5%和7%比例添加的红曲米粉（RYRP）作为天然着色剂，对高水分组织化植物蛋白（HMTVP）颜色、结构和抗氧化性能的影响。结果：红曲米粉显著改善了HMTVP的类肉颜色，其中5%添加量表现出更接近新鲜牛里脊肉的颜色特征，尤其在红度（a*）方面。在60°C加热和暗冷冻储存条件下，颜色保持相对稳定。结构分析表明，低添加水平（1%）导致蛋白质结构更松散，并降低了组织化程度。相反，较高添加水平（3%）通过增强分子间相互作用，促进了纤维结构从无序向紧凑有序的转变，并影响了水分分布。红曲米粉还以剂量依赖方式提高了HMTVP的体外抗氧化活性。结论：红曲米粉能有效改善HMTVP的颜色、结构特性和体外抗氧化活性。这些发现表明，这种天然着色剂在改善植物基肉制品颜色和整体质量属性方面具有潜力。(c) 2026 化学工业学会。
